findings.title: LDs not sole remedy
findings.deviation: The penalty is credited against damages for delay rather than being the sole and exclusive remedy.
findings.impact: AtliQ could potentially be liable for actual damages exceeding the 5% cap if the client can prove higher losses.
findings.quote: The contractual penalty shall be credited against any claim for damages for the same delay.
findings.counterPosition: The contractual penalty shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for any delay.

findings.title: Extended Confidentiality Term
findings.deviation: The confidentiality survival period is 5 years after termination, which exceeds the standard 2-3 years.
findings.impact: AtliQ must manage and track confidential information for an extended duration post-engagement.
findings.quote: The confidentiality obligation shall continue for five (5) years after termination of this Agreement.
findings.counterPosition: The confidentiality obligation shall continue for three (3) years after termination of this Agreement.

fine.note: Payment within 30 days of receipt matches the standard.
Aggregate liability capped at total remuneration (fees) for slight negligence; mandatory law carve-outs for German law (intent, gross negligence) are acceptable.
Indemnity is mutual for breach and negligence, and includes standard IP infringement coverage subject to general liability limits.
AtliQ retains ownership of its background IP (PipeKit) and grants a license, while client owns specific work results upon payment.
Termination for convenience ensures AtliQ is paid for services rendered and committed costs.
Includes a 10-day review period and deemed acceptance if the client fails to respond.
Standard data protection language referencing DPA and SCCs for transfer to India.
Requirement for written consent to subcontract is a standard operational control rather than a non-compete.
